text: 中国人民银行8月1日召开2026年下半年工作会议。会议强调，稳妥化解重点领域风险。继续做好金融支持地方政府融资平台债务风险化解工作，推进融资平台市场化转型。强化宏观审慎管理和金融稳定保障体系，丰富宏观审慎和金融稳定管理工具箱，校正和阻断金融市场风险的累积，维护金融市场稳定健康发展。发挥好两项支持资本市场货币政策工具的作用。提升存款保险履职效能。稳妥有序推进重点地区和重点机构风险化解。强化打击非法金融活动。
text_en: The People's Bank of China held its H2 2026 work conference on Aug 1. The meeting emphasized prudently resolving risks in key areas. Continued financial support for resolving debt risks of local government financing platforms, advancing their market-oriented transformation. Strengthened macroprudential management and the financial stability guarantee system, enriched macroprudential and financial stability management toolkits, corrected and interrupted the accumulation of financial market risks, and maintained sound and stable financial market development. The two monetary policy tools supporting capital markets will be put to good use. Improved the effectiveness of deposit insurance. Prudently and orderly advanced risk resolution in key regions and institutions. Intensified efforts to combat illegal financial activities.
